```{r Setup}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# set base folder
here::i_am("allocation_round1.Rmd")

# Import utils and config
purrr::walk(
  list.files(here::here("utils"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE),
  source
)
source(here("config.R"))
```

# Load and prepare data
```{r}
# Safely load topics
topics <- load_topics(here(topics_path))

print(topics)
```


```{r}
# Safely load student preferences

student_preferences_round1 <- load_student_preferences(student_preferences_round1_path, topics$topic_id)

print(student_preferences_round1)
```

# Allocate Students by Random Serial Dictatorship
```{r}
# allocate and output student perspective
allocations_round1_students <- allocate_by_rsd(student_preferences_round1, topic_capacity, allocation_seed_round1)

print(allocations_round1_students)
```



```{r}
# pivot to topic perspective
allocations_round1_supervisors <- pivot_to_topic_perspective(allocations_round1_students)

print(allocations_round1_supervisors)
```

# Write output to file

```{r}
write_csv(allocations_round1_students, allocations_round1_students_path)
write_csv(allocations_round1_supervisors, allocations_round1_supervisors_path)
```
